prompt: Top-down world map board for a quiet ink-and-wash conquest game, matching the reference exactly in palette and mood: deep indigo paper, feathered silver-ivory coastlines, territories as muted translucent washes in four colours (dusty vermilion, slate blue, ochre, sage).
